source.title: Four open problems in four dimensions

trace.notes: Input normalized as a single zbMATH URL with document identifier 829831.
Direct fetch of https://zbmath.org/829831 was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge, so the zbMATH landing page could not be used as a readable source.

Identifier-specific recovery found metadata identifying the work as 'Four open problems in four dimensions' from zbMATH-derived local candidate data and exact-title web results. Search candidates included Google Books and Perlego records for A Chaotic Hierarchy, a ScienceDirect reference listing, and Ars Electronica citation pages; these exposed only bibliographic or table-of-contents data and did not contain the chapter's problem statements.
No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML artifact was recovered, so no document map could be built.

Source adequacy gate failed: recovered candidates were metadata-only, citation-only, paywalled ebook listings, or blocked resolver pages. No questions were extracted from metadata, abstracts, snippets, or related works.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/829831.json and outputs/latest.json.
